def countdown_string(start_hhmm, end_hhmm):
    sh, sm = (int(x) for x in start_hhmm.split(':'))
    eh, em = (int(x) for x in end_hhmm.split(':'))
    diff = ((eh * 60 + em) - (sh * 60 + sm) - 1) % 1440 + 1
    return f'{diff // 60}:{diff % 60:02d}'

import re

def mask_phone_with_ext(phone_ext):
    match = re.match(r'^([\d-]+)(.*)$', phone_ext)
    main, ext = match.group(1), match.group(2)
    digits = re.sub(r'\D', '', main)
    keep = digits[-4:]
    masked_digits = '*' * (len(digits) - 4) + keep
    it = iter(masked_digits)
    masked_main = ''.join(next(it) if c != '-' else '-' for c in main)
    return masked_main + ext
